shape: 4-portal cross arena (N+S+W+E gates) with central super-hub
description: Four-portal arena where all four gates fan into a CENTER super-hub (gzn6yb). The CENTER reaches all four entry hubs (j23yxt north, so954g west, 1xxydp south, ql1owe east) plus a NW pocket (bnq1im) and an east-mid corner (1jxfmf). The NW pocket (bnq1im) is wired into three west-side hubs (j23yxt, so954g, gzn6yb) for a small triangle. The EAST clique (1xxydp + 1jxfmf + ql1owe) is also a triangle off the CENTER. Most compact 4-portal stage authored.

portals.north: spawn_north at (-9.38, -4.19) — gate on the north (low-Z) side
portals.south: spawn_south at (16.98, 17.46) — gate on the south (high-Z) side
portals.west: spawn_west at (-23.11, 17.35) — gate on the west (low-X) side
portals.east: spawn_east at (23.28, -14.15) — gate on the east (high-X) side

anchors.description: NW pocket - triangle with north_inner + west_inner + center (matches bnq1im)
east-mid corner - east triangle with south_inner + east_inner + center (matches 1jxfmf)

traversalNotes: Direct N→S: spawn_north → north_inner → center → south_inner → spawn_south. 4 hops.
Direct N→W: spawn_north → north_inner → west_inner → spawn_west. 3 hops.
Direct N→E: spawn_north → north_inner → center → east_inner → spawn_east. 4 hops.
Direct W→S: spawn_west → west_inner → center → south_inner → spawn_south. 4 hops.
Direct W→E: spawn_west → west_inner → center → east_inner → spawn_east. 4 hops.
Direct S→E: spawn_south → south_inner → east_inner → spawn_east. 3 hops via the east triangle.
DISPATCH RULE: center (gzn6yb) is the canonical 4-portal dispatcher — reaches all four entry hubs in 1 hop.
Two triangles: NW (north_inner + west_inner + nw_pocket + center) and EAST (south_inner + east_inner + east_mid + center). Pick the closer side of the triangle.
